title: Nuclear Weapons Glossary — 50 Defined Terms (Yield, Fallout, MIRV, MAD) | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A clear, sourced glossary of nuclear weapons terminology — yield, fireball, overpressure, fallout, MIRV, ICBM, MAD, NPT and more. Each term has a one-sentence answer plus a deeper explanation.

title: Acute Radiation Syndrome — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The constellation of medical symptoms following a high dose of ionizing radiation, including nausea, immune-system failure, hemorrhage, and death.

title: Air Burst — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A nuclear detonation above the ground at optimal altitude, maximizing the area affected by blast and thermal radiation while producing minimal fallout.

title: Atomic Bomb — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A nuclear weapon whose energy comes from nuclear fission of uranium-235 or plutonium-239.

title: Boosted Fission — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A fission weapon design in which a small amount of deuterium-tritium gas is injected into the fissile core to enhance yield.

title: Counterforce — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A nuclear targeting strategy aimed at destroying an opponent's military forces, especially their nuclear weapons and command-and-control.

title: Countervalue — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A nuclear targeting strategy aimed at destroying an opponent's population centers, industry, and economic infrastructure.

title: Critical Mass — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The minimum amount of fissile material required to sustain a self-propagating nuclear chain reaction.

title: Cruise Missile — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A self-propelled jet- or rocket-powered missile that flies a low, terrain-following trajectory to a target.

title: CTBT (Comprehensive Test Ban Treaty) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A 1996 treaty banning all nuclear explosions in all environments, for both military and civilian purposes.

title: Dead Hand — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A semi-automated Soviet (and reportedly current Russian) nuclear-retaliation system that can launch a counterstrike even if national leadership has been killed.

title: Deuterium — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A heavy isotope of hydrogen with one neutron, used as fusion fuel in thermonuclear weapons.

title: EMP (Electromagnetic Pulse) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A burst of electromagnetic energy released by a nuclear detonation, capable of damaging or destroying unhardened electronics over a wide area.

title: Fallout — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: Radioactive material thrown into the atmosphere by a surface-burst nuclear detonation, which then settles back to earth over hours to weeks.

title: Fireball — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The sphere of plasma created by a nuclear detonation, with internal temperatures exceeding 10 million °C — hotter than the surface of the Sun.

title: First Strike — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A nuclear attack intended to disarm an opponent before they can retaliate, by destroying their nuclear forces, command, and control.

title: Gamma Radiation — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: High-energy electromagnetic radiation emitted by nuclear processes, capable of penetrating most materials and damaging living tissue.

title: Half-Life — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The time required for half of a quantity of a radioactive isotope to decay.

title: Hydrogen Bomb — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A nuclear weapon that derives most of its energy from nuclear fusion of hydrogen isotopes, ignited by a fission primary stage.

title: ICBM (Intercontinental Ballistic Missile) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A long-range ballistic missile (range > 5,500 km) designed to deliver nuclear warheads between continents.

title: Kiloton (kt) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A unit of nuclear yield equal to 1,000 tons of TNT equivalent (4.184 × 10¹² joules).

title: MAD (Mutually Assured Destruction) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A Cold War strategic doctrine in which two or more nuclear-armed adversaries each possess sufficient retaliatory capability that any nuclear attack would result in their own destruction.

title: Megaton (Mt) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A unit of nuclear yield equal to 1,000,000 tons (or 1,000 kilotons) of TNT equivalent.

title: MIRV — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: Multiple Independently-targetable Reentry Vehicle — a single missile carrying several warheads, each able to strike a different target.

title: Neutron Bomb — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A small thermonuclear weapon designed to maximize neutron radiation output relative to blast and thermal effects.

title: New START — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A 2010 US–Russia treaty limiting each side to 1,550 deployed strategic nuclear warheads and 700 deployed delivery systems.

title: NPT (Non-Proliferation Treaty) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The 1968 Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons, which restricts nuclear-weapon possession to five recognized states and obligates them to pursue disarmament.

title: Nuclear Deterrence — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The strategy of preventing adversary action by maintaining a credible threat of unacceptable nuclear retaliation.

title: Nuclear Fission — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The splitting of heavy atomic nuclei (typically uranium-235 or plutonium-239) into lighter fragments, releasing large amounts of energy.

title: Nuclear Fusion — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The combination of light atomic nuclei (typically deuterium and tritium) into heavier nuclei, releasing energy.

title: Nuclear Triad — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A three-pronged nuclear force structure consisting of land-based ICBMs, submarine-launched ballistic missiles (SLBMs), and strategic bombers.

title: Nuclear Winter — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A hypothesized severe global cooling caused by soot from urban firestorms following a large-scale nuclear war.

title: Overpressure — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The pressure above atmospheric pressure produced by the blast wave of a nuclear detonation, measured in pounds per square inch (PSI).

title: Permissive Action Link (PAL) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A security device built into nuclear weapons that prevents unauthorized arming or detonation without the correct code.

title: Plutonium-239 — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A fissile isotope of plutonium produced from uranium-238 in nuclear reactors and used in most modern fission weapons.

title: PSI (Pounds per Square Inch) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The unit used to measure blast overpressure from a nuclear detonation.

title: Second-Degree Burns — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: Partial-thickness burns affecting both the epidermis and dermis, characterized by blistering and pain.

title: Second Strike — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The retaliatory nuclear capability remaining after absorbing an opponent's first strike — the foundation of deterrence under MAD.

title: Sievert (Sv) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The SI unit of equivalent dose of ionizing radiation, accounting for biological effect.

title: SLBM (Submarine-Launched Ballistic Missile) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A ballistic missile launched from a submerged submarine, providing a survivable second-strike nuclear capability.

title: Strategic Nuclear Weapon — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A nuclear weapon designed for long-range strikes against an adversary's population centers, industrial base, or strategic infrastructure.

title: Surface Burst — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A nuclear detonation at ground level, producing roughly 40-50% smaller blast radius than an air burst but creating massive radioactive fallout.

title: Tactical Nuclear Weapon — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A nuclear weapon designed for battlefield use, typically with low yield (sub-kiloton to ~50 kilotons) and short range.

title: Teller-Ulam Design — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The two-stage design used in nearly all modern thermonuclear weapons, named after physicists Edward Teller and Stanislaw Ulam.

title: Thermal Radiation — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The intense pulse of light and infrared radiation emitted by the fireball of a nuclear detonation, capable of causing burns and igniting fires at long distances.

title: Thermonuclear Weapon — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: Synonym for hydrogen bomb — a nuclear weapon whose primary energy comes from fusion reactions.

title: TPNW (Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons) — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A 2017 UN treaty that prohibits all activities related to nuclear weapons — development, possession, testing, threats of use — for state parties.
h1: TPNW (Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons)

title: Tritium — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A radioactive heavy isotope of hydrogen with two neutrons, used as fusion fuel and in boosted-fission weapons.

title: Uranium-235 — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: A fissile isotope of uranium that constitutes the explosive material in many fission weapons.

title: Warhead — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The explosive payload of a missile, bomb, or other weapon system; for nuclear weapons, the package containing the fissile or fusion material.

title: Yield — Nuclear Weapons Glossary | NukeBlastSimulator.com
meta_description: The total energy released by a nuclear weapon, expressed in tons (or kilotons / megatons) of TNT equivalent.
